commander: Search assigned quadrants and extract all 12 survivors by tick 60, physically relaying coordinates near base (7,7) whenever communications fail.

intents.S1: Sweep NW quadrant continuously; if cut off, fly survivor coordinates directly to R1 or base (7,7) every 15 ticks.
intents.S2: Sweep NE quadrant; when cut off, keep sweeping and carry survivor locations to R2 or base (7,7) every 15 ticks.
intents.S3: Sweep SW quadrant; when cut off, keep sweeping and relay survivor coords to R1 or base (7,7) every 15 ticks.
intents.S4: Sweep SE quadrant autonomously; while dark, log all survivors and return to base (7,7) or R2 every 20 ticks.
intents.R1: Rescue West half survivors avoiding water; if cut off, clear known targets then patrol near base (7,7) for scout updates.
intents.R2: Rescue East half survivors avoiding water; when cut off, finish known rescues then move toward base (7,7) to meet scouts.
